name: PoolCar Dev Container
postCreateCommand: dotnet tool restore && dotnet husky install && (command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1 || (curl -sSfL https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.30.1/gitleaks_8.30.1_linux_x64.tar.gz | sudo tar -xz -C /usr/local/bin gitleaks && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/gitleaks)) && dotnet build && (pwsh tests/PoolCar.EndToEnd.Tests/bin/Debug/net10.0/playwright.ps1 install --with-deps chromium || true)
